transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator recerts next week, and two training area blocks available: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. We need to figure out the schedule and get Alpha's evaluator nailed down. Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle, so that's not our concern right now. Who's got what on availability and evaluator assignments?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the training database this morning — Sgt. Lewis is the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort, and he's available Monday 0800-1200. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, but I can confirm his authorization is current.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical before we lock anything in. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo's cohort can only train Tuesday 1300-1700, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so if we put Bravo in the Monday block, we'd have a conflict.
transcript.speaker: A3
